original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Max Power Capacity as a raw WORD with the applicable SMBIOS unit and 8000h unknown semantics against approved PSU design data, and confirm stability after reboot.
original_method: Length-check every Type 39 record, decode the capacity WORD without treating 8000h as a number, bind it to supply identity, compare under the approved version/unit/tolerance policy and repeat after reboot—without live load testing.
manual_activity: A user supplies the applicable version/unit, per-PSU rating and tolerance and approves reboot; no physical load or PSU action is part of this metadata test.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 capacity unit/version rule
Expected maximum sustained output per PSU model/identity and tolerance
Validated raw decoder/read-only FRU inventory and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not load-test, overload, unplug or switch a PSU to validate metadata.
Preserve raw little-endian WORD and interpret 8000h only as the specified unknown sentinel.
Do not compare decoded numbers until unit/version policy is resolved.
Stop on power/management degradation; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate record length, decode raw capacity/sentinel per identity, apply approved unit/tolerance, correlate read-only model/FRU data and diff pre/post reboot.
Report invalid encoding, unit uncertainty, mismatches or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the controlling SMBIOS unit interpretation, PSU capacity/tolerance and reboot plan.
Resolve unknown or model-rating exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but formatted grep cannot prove raw WORD, record length, 8000h handling, supply identity or unit interpretation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 39; emit supply identity, raw WORD, sentinel state, version-bound unit, normalized value, rating/tolerance result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Max Power Capacity scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no load stimulus is added.

modernized_recommendation.status: RAW SENTINEL- AND UNIT-AWARE CAPACITY VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the Type 39 WORD only after length validation, branch explicitly on 8000h, apply the approved spec-version unit and compare with per-model design capacity rather than measured load.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and inventory versions used to select the unit rule.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Max Power Capacity WORD and unknown-sentinel definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw/sentinel validation, unit provenance, identity-specific tolerance and rejects load testing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects sentinel-as-number errors, unit scaling defects, truncation and mismatched PSU ratings.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved version/unit, rating and tolerance policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The record is declarative metadata; it does not prove real-time delivery capacity or redundancy behavior.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve model-specific tolerances or an allowed 8000h unknown state, but must record unit provenance and cannot replace metadata validation with a stress/load test.
expected_evidence: Approved SMBIOS unit/version, 8000h and tolerance policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 39 handles/lengths and raw capacity WORDs
Statement that no power load or PSU manipulation occurred
Approved reboot/health record, post-reboot diff and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The field is valid; the controlling unit/version and expected rating are readiness inputs that must be explicit.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding and design-data comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds WORD/sentinel, unit/version, identity and no-load-test semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safety/coverage while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates unresolved project/spec inputs from capability and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents 8000h from becoming a huge numeric rating and prevents an unsafe live-load experiment from being used to validate declarative firmware metadata.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a version-governed encoded capacity field; validity depends on raw WORD semantics and model identity, while actual load capability is outside its scope.
